name: Sika Filler-105
paste:
SIKA® FILLER-105: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Filler-105, April 2023, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sika_filler-105.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Filler-105 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Filler-105 is a water based, ready to use thick layer surface filler for internal surfaces.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sika® Filler-105 is suitable for indoor filling and repair where thicker filling capability are needed
    - A finer grade filler such as Sika® Filler-101 should be used for finishing surfaces before painting
    - Sika® Filler-105 complies with EN 15824 “Specifications for external and internal plasters based on organic binders”

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Filler-105
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Ready to use water based thick layer surface filler
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Internal plaster based on organic binder according to EN 15824, DoP 02 03 04 02 001 0 000017 1084; ITT performed by external laboratory 0402; System 3 certification and provided with the CE-mark
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 15824: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1); Uses (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Ready to use, no mixing required
    - Easy application
    - Thick layer filling and levelling ability
    - High initial tack or grab on plaster and concrete
    - Quick drying
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Filled styrene-acrylate dispersion
    - Appearance and colour: Light grey paste
    - Density: ~0.900 kg/l
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Maximum grain size: Dmax: 0.30 mm
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 250 ml plastic tube; 400 ml plastic tube; 5 Ltr plastic pail
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production if stored properly in undamaged and unopened original sealed packaging
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry conditions. Protect from frost.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment. Clean, free from dust, dry and oil.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: This depends on the substrate roughness and thickness of the layer applied. As a guide, ~ 1 l of Sika® Filler-105 can fill ~ 1 m² per mm thick.
    - Layer thickness: 1 mm min. / 15 mm max.
    - Waiting time to overcoating: ~ 12 hours (ideally surfaces should be finished with a fine layer filler such as Sika® Filler-101)
4.3 Mixing. Sika® Filler-105 is supplied ready to use - no mixing is required.
4.4 Application. Sika® Filler-105 can be applied with a spatula in layer thicknesses from 0 - 30 mm. When filling deep holes or cracks above 4 mm the filler should be applied in several layers and must be allowed to almost dry before each subsequent layer is applied
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5°C min. / +35°C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5°C min. / +35°C max.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Filler-105, April 2023, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sika_filler-105.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Filler 105, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/MSDS%20Sika%20Filler-105%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
